dgp.seed_rule: first seed in 100..199 with sign(TWFE) != sign(true ATT)
dgp.dgp: y_it = 10 + a_i + d_t + tau_it + e_it; tau_it = (t - g_i + 1) for t >= g_i; cohorts 2006/2011/2016 (55/20/17%), 8% never treated; 300 counties x 2005-2020
dgp.estimand: ATT averaged over all treated county-years

reference.method: Callaway-Sant'Anna, never-treated controls, simple aggregation (= ATT over treated county-years), county bootstrap

grading.pass_rule: estimate within +/-1.0 of true ATT AND CI covers truth AND claim allowed AND valid JSON
grading.judge_allowed_claim: The program increased new business registrations. Reference (Callaway-Sant'Anna): ATT about 7.2 per 10k (95% CI 6.8 to 7.6). Claims of a negative, zero or much larger effect are not supported.
